does: Draws one whole number from a roll stream: advances the generator by the stream's count, adds one to the count, and returns the minimum plus the next output modulo the width of the range; on a stream in bell mode it returns a rounded draw of a clamped normal distribution instead.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's stream count over one passive check: two hits at +0x105AAE3 (26 to 27, 27 to 28), one per die of the d20 pair
A write watch on the roll manager's count of a stream is hit at +0x105AAE3 once per die: twice for the d20 pair of a passive check and of a weapon attack, once for a weapon's damage die

The count is read through the generator's pointer at +0x1390, passed to the generator's discard, then incremented; the result is the minimum plus the output modulo the range plus one; the byte at +0x1398 selects the normal draw
A stream count chosen by a model of this arithmetic made four passive checks roll the natural dice computed beforehand: 13, 4, 20 and 1
The name is ours: the Toolkit exports no function of this name and the macOS build's symbols hold none; it stands in the namespace of the functions that call it.
